rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates with Wireshark's tshark command-line tool to provide network packet analysis capabilities. Supports packet capture, protocol hierarchy statistics, endpoint and conversation tracking, HTTP request and DNS query extraction, file export from captures, threat intelligence checks, and credential detection. Requires Python 3.10+ and Wireshark with tshark accessible in the system PATH.
